text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон skips our first day of
training for the
Champions Cup. Instead,
I find her by the river.

Смарт Фалкон's worries are laid bare.
Caught up in
aiming for the top, she no
longer enjoys the act
of performing, so I
ask her to sing something on
the spot.

Our little concert helps Смарт Фалкон
remember
her initial resolution—her
original dream to simply
shine.

I reassure her that she's never truly lost
that shine.
With newfound confidence,
she looks ahead to
her next race.
